settings.title: The Origin
settings.body: It started with a single sack of green beans and a fire that wouldn't quit. Sasquatch roasted through the night; the forest woke up to the smell of it.

settings.title: Our Mission
settings.body: Premium, small-batch coffee roasted over the perfect fire — and shared with anyone who wanders down the trail.

settings.title: Coffee Philosophy
settings.body: Slow roasts, honest sourcing, and a deep respect for the woods that raised us. Simon insists on testing every batch. Repeatedly.

settings.heading: Roasted over the perfect fire
settings.text: We roast in small batches so every bean hits its sweet spot. No shortcuts, no stale shelves — just coffee the way the forest intended.

settings.quote: Best coffee I've had in years. Tastes like a crisp morning in the mountains.
settings.author: Jordan M.

settings.quote: The whole shop experience is magical. My kids ask to 'visit Simon' every week.
settings.author: Priya K.

settings.quote: Roasted-to-order really is a different league. Won't go back to grocery beans.
settings.author: Marcus T.

settings.question: How fresh is the coffee?
settings.answer: Every bag is roasted to order in small batches and shipped within 1–2 days — never off a warehouse shelf.

settings.question: Which grind should I choose?
settings.answer: Whole bean for the freshest cup, or pick your brewer's grind at checkout. Simon recommends coarse for cold brew, standard for drip.

settings.question: Do you offer subscriptions?
settings.answer: Yes — save on every order and never run out. Look for the subscribe option on any coffee product.

settings.question: What's your return policy?
settings.answer: If you're not happy with your roast, reach out and we'll make it right. That's the camp promise.

settings.heading: Get 10% off your first bag
settings.text: Join the camp for new roasts, seasonal drops, and the occasional secret from Simon's notebook.
